designs.title: Point
designs.meaning: a position and nothing else: somewhere to begin. Palle, 2026-11-08: 'The point is genesis'

designs.title: extension(point) = black point
designs.meaning: the position takes a body small enough to hold. Palle, 2026-11-08: 'extension(point) = black dot, is better in our hand, it is desire'; 'extension is body'

designs.title: line = distance(point, point)
designs.meaning: two positions ask how far apart they are. Palle, 2026-11-08: 'line = distance(point, point)'

designs.title: A blank card
designs.meaning: For the transition the timeline does not have yet: write your own (duplicate it in the designer and fill the three rules). The set should not decide in advance how a visitor may object.

designs.meaning: What is foreclosed? Thinking made harder under this structure; the grammar it installs, at what cost.

designs.title: observed
designs.meaning: Observed: seen with a body, in the headset or in the room.

designs.title: proposed
designs.meaning: An organisation offered for revision, not part of the source: the mark an agent's sticker carries until a hand adopts it.

designs.title: rehearsal, not reception
designs.meaning: AI critique cannot refuse you; it costs a revision, never a withdrawal. Rehearsal, not reception.

designs.title: #EB0D85
designs.meaning: Naming a colour does not capture it, but it makes the gap between name and experience visible. Silence = Death pink.

designs.title: Primitives: Points Build Worlds
designs.meaning: A position, a visible surface and a physical boundary are different constructions. Their relations can be made and changed. (Order (F): Foundation - points, lines, planes, and basic vectors)

designs.title: Transformation: What Stays the Same When Everything Changes
designs.meaning: Changing position, orientation or size changes possible passage. Ask which properties survive each operation and which body the resulting space admits. (Order (F): Invariants - dot/cross products enable rotation)

designs.title: Logic: Conditions Become Events
designs.meaning: A condition is encountered through what a construction lets happen. (Order (F): Make conditions, alternative routes and physical consequences explicit; assemble with familiar parts.)

designs.meaning: A colour value enters an encounter: a light, a surface, a position, a neighbour and a viewer. Implement each relation, then examine what the implementation leaves out. (Order (F): Foundation - colour systems become composition systems, on an index the arrays supply: address, then attribute, then rule, then the made thing)

designs.title: Patterns: Dress the Architecture
designs.meaning: A source, a copying rule and a receiving surface each contribute to a pattern. Keep one fixed and change another: what returns as the same, and what becomes possible for a body? (Order (F): Foundation - colour systems become composition systems, on an index the arrays supply: address, then attribute, then rule, then the made thing)

designs.title: Change: Rate, Accumulation, and Flow
designs.meaning: A value, a local rate and an accumulated total retain different things. Repeated updates can make the next address depend on the path already taken. (Order (F): Foundation - the calculus substrate. Derivative as instantaneous rate, integral as accumulation, vector field as flow. The vocabulary forces / wavefunctions / randomness / noise will all use.)

designs.title: Vectors & Forces: From Direction to Dynamics
designs.meaning: An arrow does not decide what happens. Its quantity, frame, receiver and retained state give it a consequence. (Oscillation (F ↔ E): Newton's laws - vectors become physics)

designs.title: Form Finding: Rules, Constraints and Possible Shapes
designs.meaning: A chosen update, objective and set of constraints make some configurations accessible. An accepted endpoint depends on the model and its stopping rule. (Order (F): Foundation - the F term made physical; free-energy minimization as the shape matter settles into, stopping short of the dead-perfect bottom)

designs.title: Wavefunctions: What Returns
designs.meaning: Returning to one value need not mean returning to the same state. Follow what a repeated movement carries into a record, a space, a sound and a sum. (Oscillation (F ↔ E): F ↔ E oscillation - sine creates curves)

designs.title: Randomness: What Can Chance Change?
designs.meaning: A draw enters a world that has already made choices: its possible values, their distribution, the eligible bodies, the clock, the memory and the consequences. (Entropy (E(S)): Disorder as creative force)

designs.title: Noise: Fields and Possible Bodies
designs.meaning: A field can be read as colour, relief, an address or a threshold. Each use makes different bodies and passages possible. (Entropy (E(S)): Structured randomness - Perlin, flow fields)

designs.meaning: A familiar form can be evaluated as a surface rule. Coordinates, material, light and viewpoint affect its appearance; mesh geometry, collision and retained state remain distinct constructions. (Entropy (E(S)): A rule for every pixel at once - the field becomes a surface that answers light, position and time)

designs.title: Cellular Automata: What a Neighbour Can Change
designs.meaning: A field keeps states at addresses. Its neighbourhood, update schedule, boundary and input determine how those states can change. (Edge of Chaos (λ): Simple rules → complex behavior. Rule 110 is Turing complete — the λ_edge thesis.)

designs.title: Fractals: Rules, Scale and Room to Move
designs.meaning: A finite construction lets us investigate repeated rules, scale, removal and the cost of further detail. (Edge of Chaos (λ): Self-similarity, infinite detail)

designs.meaning: A sentence can become a forest. Grammar is generative. (Edge of Chaos (λ): Generative grammars)

designs.title: Procedural Generation: Rules Build Worlds
designs.meaning: A generated world carries choices about representation, growth, connection and support. Those choices can be inspected and revised. (Edge of Chaos (λ): WFC, Markov, emergence from rules)

designs.title: Soft Bodies & Morphogenesis: Matter That Finds Its Shape
designs.meaning: Form is not imposed -- it emerges from the material's own dynamics. (Integration (φΔE): Deformable matter, cloth, fluid + Turing morphogenesis. Cloth descends an energy landscape under gravity + spring constraints.)

designs.title: Isosurfaces: Implicit to Explicit
designs.meaning: A field assigns values; sampling and a chosen level make a boundary available to construct. (Order (F): Implicit fields → explicit surfaces. Marching cubes as the bridge from continuous fields to walkable mesh.)

designs.title: Boolean Surfaces: CSG as Composition
designs.meaning: Union, intersection and difference compose solid regions; collision and clearance determine how a body can inhabit the result. (Order (F): CSG operations as composition logic — union, intersection, difference of solids.)

designs.title: Swarm Intelligence: Where Coordination Lives
designs.meaning: Collective movement does not identify its cause. Look for the field, neighbour, memory, objective and support that make it possible. (Edge of Chaos (λ): Collective behavior, stigmergy — local rules + memory of rules → emergent global pattern. Swarm's qfep_term is self-declared λ.)

designs.meaning: The same connections can host different journeys. What the graph leaves out will not be recovered by choosing another route. (Relation (substrate): Connections define structure. The substrate that was always under it all — every cell, force, agent, neuron was a node; every adjacency, attraction, message, weight was an edge.)

designs.meaning: A change in appearance is not yet evidence of learning. Follow what changes, what measures it and what stays fixed. (Integration (φΔE): Learning systems, neural networks)

designs.title: Foundations Crisis: The Limits of Formalization
designs.meaning: Different formal systems and representations have different powers and limits. Investigate their assumptions before generalising. (Synthesis: Gödel, Russell - limits of formal systems)

designs.title: QFEP Laboratory: The Formula Made Interactive
designs.meaning: A manipulable formula becomes accountable through explicit quantities, receivers and tests. (Synthesis: The complete QFEP formula embodied)

designs.title: Post-Crisis: Applied Limits
designs.meaning: Knowing the limits of formalization, what do we build? (Synthesis: Applied limits — bias, rhizomes, molecular design as post-crisis practice)

designs.title: A compass can draw any circle / and cannot draw its way…
designs.meaning: "A compass can draw any circle and cannot draw its way out of the plane." (Primitives_Melencolia, primitives)

designs.title: Mathematics never gets there. / Floats do, by forgetting.
designs.meaning: "The machine reaches the limit by running out of digits. Mathematics never gets there. Floats do, by forgetting." (Primitives_Portals, primitives)

designs.title: Nobody drew the amphora. / Somebody chose a stiffness …
designs.meaning: "Nobody drew the amphora. Somebody chose a stiffness, a pinned collar, an initial expansion and a number of steps, and the amphora is what those choices left." (FormFinding_Relaxation, formfinding)

designs.title: Everything worked, / and this happened.
designs.meaning: "Everything worked, and this happened." (Change_Choreography, forces)

designs.title: The place is the same. / The state is not.
designs.meaning: "Returning to a place need not mean returning to the same moment in a movement. The place is the same. The state is not." (WaveFunctions_Intro, wavefunctions)

designs.title: A crossing can repeat / Your knowledge survives the reset.
designs.meaning: "Your knowledge survives the reset. A crossing can repeat while the person crossing it cannot return to not knowing." (Random_Game, randomness)

designs.title: Zero total length / and uncountably many points
designs.meaning: "Its limiting set has zero total length and uncountably many points." (Fractal_CantorSet, fractals)

designs.title: Being present / and being counted have parted company
designs.meaning: "Only the active state, numbered one, contributes to the count. A green neighbour holds state two. Being present and being counted have parted company." (CA_ElementaryRules, cellularautomata)

designs.title: Their letters have not changed. / Another route through…
designs.meaning: "Their letters have not changed. Each still carries five drawing instructions, yet the same route through the symbols takes another route through space." (LSystems_Grammar_Lab, lsystems)

designs.title: The numbers return / sooner than the body.
designs.meaning: "Restore the settings while the cube is moving. It continues from where it has arrived. The numbers return sooner than the body." (SoftBodies_Soft_Body_Deformation, softbodies)

designs.title: The sphere disappears from view / while its contour remains
designs.meaning: "the sphere disappears from view while its contour remains in the other body. Absence has been given a surface." (Boolean_Verbs, boolean_surfaces)

designs.title: You moved. / A movement nobody quite made
designs.meaning: "A movement nobody quite made ... The recording has an occasion: you moved. The mean has a calculation." (ML_Generative, machinelearning)

designs.title: Adding the sentence moves the gap up. / It does not close…
designs.meaning: "A pulse climbs it and finds the gap again on every level. Adding the sentence moves the gap up. It does not close it." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The closed leaf lets you pass. / Turn back: it is still…
designs.meaning: "Walk through. The closed leaf lets you pass. Turn back: it is still there." (Florensky_Paraconsistent, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: My first number was not its first number.
designs.meaning: "The number has moved on. My first number was not its first number." (Point_Zero, primitives)

designs.title: Three cones around nothing.
designs.meaning: "Three cones around nothing. There was a hole here, in the code, and it is no longer drawn; the cordon stayed." (Primitives_Ignorance, primitives)

designs.title: I press my thumb … once, to see if that was it.

layers.text: TO SEE IF THAT WAS IT.

designs.meaning: "At the opening I press my thumb against the side of my finger, once, to see if that was it." (Point_One, primitives)

designs.title: A rather poor marker … but I know where to look.

layers.text: BUT I KNOW WHERE TO LOOK.

designs.meaning: "I put the black point approximately where the white one was. When I release it, the light goes out. It makes a rather poor marker in this light, but I know where to look." (Point_Coordinates, primitives)

designs.title: Even the black corner has been brightened slightly
designs.meaning: "Even the black corner has been brightened slightly so that you can find it." (Color_Walls, color)

designs.title: The hand … is already wearing the last one.
designs.meaning: "Reach for the point again. The hand making the next choice is already wearing the last one." (Color_Nails, color)

designs.meaning: "Wait with one mark. It is there, then absent. No fading gives it a farewell." (WaveFunctions_Pendulum, wavefunctions)

designs.title: The same address from a little lower down.
designs.meaning: "When the surface gives way, you are still looking at the same address from a little lower down." (CA_ExpandingSpace, cellularautomata)

designs.title: The alloy without its tears.
designs.meaning: "The last body is a cube of a metal the header calls sad, with streaks that were meant to run down it like tears. ... What you see is the alloy without its tears." (Shader_11_QueerRubber, shaders)

designs.title: Look for a mouth.
designs.meaning: "Its surface can meet your body; transparency has not made it passable. Look for a mouth." (SoftBodies_Playground_of_Joy, softbodies)

designs.title: Add a ring … The number has not moved.
designs.meaning: "Add a ring to the leader. Look through its opening, then back at the score. A conspicuous part has appeared. The number has not moved." (PG_Genetic_Evolution, proceduralgeneration)

designs.title: The hand has arrived. Your hand is missing.
designs.meaning: "The hand has arrived. Your hand is missing." (PostCrisis_Synthesis, postfoundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The screen stops at five. Its smallest pieces still have width, height and depth. ... Its limiting set has zero total length and uncountably many points. We have not displayed that limit. We have made a finite instrument for approaching its rule." (Fractal_CantorSet, fractals; cannot claim) Beyond it: Only the mathematical construction, continued without a last cut, reaches a set of zero length and uncountably many points; a finite drawing can approach its rule but not show it.

designs.meaning: "The missing path saves work and storage. It also closes a question. From this record alone, we cannot ask whether the hand moved carefully, reluctantly or with delight. Increasing the precision of its final coordinates would not recover the movement." (PostCrisis_Synthesis, postfoundationscrisis; leaves out) Beyond it: Keeping the hand's path, another version of the pose or the reason it was tried, though the text says none of these would keep the whole event.

designs.meaning: "The code can name a clearance. It cannot decide whose body ought to be the measure." (Trans_Scale, transformation; still open) Beyond it: A judgement about whose body is the norm, which the code cannot make and which the visitor is left to weigh by widening the opening.

designs.meaning: "After enough time with these four rails, we may begin looking only for things that fit them. ... What have they made harder to think? What continues beyond their reach? The museum must be able to ask this of its own rooms, including this one." designs.meaning: "Palle's body-side registers (punctum/thrownness, ... the buzz/haptic, 'you are here', small/medium/large) did NOT fall out of ... the corpus — they live in VR and walked prose, not card text. ... the darkest fold: what the body knows and the book cannot yet say." (doc/book/LOG.md; dark spot) Beyond it: A second, hand-named source of registers from walks in the headset, read against the measured matrix; where the two disagree is what the book has yet to learn to say.

designs.title: Your hand has somewhere to go; / the proposed set does not.
designs.meaning: "Your hand has somewhere to go; the proposed set does not." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Neither button is broken.
designs.meaning: "Neither button is broken." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: An offended expectation / is not yet an inconsistency.
designs.meaning: "An offended expectation is not yet an inconsistency." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: An exception is a new arrangement, / not a hidden answer…
designs.meaning: "An exception is a new arrangement, not a hidden answer to the old one." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: An enclosing wall can be drawn / the collection its label…
designs.meaning: "An enclosing wall can be drawn even when the collection its label promises cannot exist as a set." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The room's walls have let us pass. / Its rule has not let…
designs.meaning: "The room's walls have let us pass. Its rule has not let every imagined object follow." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: More processing time will not produce a third Boolean.
designs.meaning: "More processing time will not produce a third Boolean." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: it is not that the answer is hidden. / The thing I am…
designs.meaning: "So it is not that the answer is hidden. The thing I am asking about is not there." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The paradox is not in R. / It is in the promise.
designs.meaning: "The paradox is not in R. It is in the promise." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The feeling is the same in all three. / The feeling is not…
designs.meaning: "The feeling is the same in all three. The feeling is not the test." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: something lies outside it. / NOTHING IS EVERYTHING.
designs.meaning: "whatever U you bring, something lies outside it. NOTHING IS EVERYTHING." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: the paradox did not go away. / from breaking the system to…
designs.meaning: "the paradox did not go away. it changed job: from breaking the system to measuring it." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Is that something FOUND there, / or do I MAKE it by asking?
designs.meaning: "Is that something FOUND there, or do I MAKE it by asking?" (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: pick, repair, or live with it.
designs.meaning: "They are three different things to do next: pick, repair, or live with it." (Russell_Paradox, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The machine is a timed sculpture of an argument, / not a…
designs.meaning: "The machine is a timed sculpture of an argument, not a running proof search." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Searching for such an object / and checking one that has…
designs.meaning: "Searching for such an object and checking one that has already been supplied are different tasks." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: a green light you have never seen fail / is a claim about…
designs.meaning: "a green light you have never seen fail is a claim about the instrument as much as about the world" (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: add a critic and the blind spot moves, / and never goes
designs.meaning: "add a critic and the blind spot moves, and never goes" (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: hide the gap or show it, / and this one shows it.
designs.meaning: "A construction that cannot close itself has two honest endings, hide the gap or show it, and this one shows it." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: fluent agreement is no substitute / the input, the rule…
designs.meaning: "fluent agreement is no substitute for identifying the input, the rule and the result we actually checked" (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Incompleteness does not certify every unsupported belief
designs.meaning: "Incompleteness does not certify every unsupported belief" (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Without them it is not a theorem, / it is a mood.
designs.meaning: "Without them it is not a theorem, it is a mood." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: A jam shows me one attempt ending.
designs.meaning: "A jam shows me one attempt ending." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Here the repair works every time / and is never finished.
designs.meaning: "Here the repair works every time and is never finished." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: is always said from one step outside, / about a theory one…
designs.meaning: "is always said from one step outside, about a theory one trusts." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: the totality does not exist. / it exists and cannot be…
designs.meaning: "Russell: the totality does not exist. Goedel: it exists and cannot be generated." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: a limit on checking everything / is not a licence to check…
designs.meaning: "a limit on checking everything is not a licence to check nothing." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: say it with PROVABLE instead of TRUE, / true, and outside…
designs.meaning: "say it with PROVABLE instead of TRUE, and the flipped row lands - true, and outside what can be proved." (Godel_Incompleteness, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: A straight chord would take a shorter route / but that…
designs.meaning: "A straight chord would take a shorter route through the sphere's interior, but that route has left the space in which this triangle lives." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: A limit of access / can look like a limit of the object
designs.meaning: "A limit of access can look like a limit of the object until the two are separated." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Neither operation bends the museum around you.
designs.meaning: "Neither operation bends the museum around you." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: An operation can remain precise / when its result becomes…
designs.meaning: "An operation can remain precise when its result becomes unfamiliar." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The changed sum need not be a broken triangle.
designs.meaning: "The changed sum need not be a broken triangle." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: This continuity is useful, / but it is not sameness in…
designs.meaning: "This continuity is useful, but it is not sameness in every respect." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The visible rim is infinitely far away
designs.meaning: "The visible rim is infinitely far away in that metric." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The triangle did not change. / I changed what a side is.
designs.meaning: "The triangle did not change. I changed what a side is." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: What travels: the record. / What does not: distances,…
designs.meaning: "What travels: the record. What does not: distances, angles, the sum." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "if I forget which space the corners belong to." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The picture ends. The thing it shows does not." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "Which one the world has is not decided by the triangle on the bench." (NonEuclidean_Spaces, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "GOLD removes the fifth's special emphasis. Its sentence remains." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "You can withdraw the gold and still be standing in the same geometry." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "Parallel does not mean evenly spaced." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "Those numbers were supplied; the drawn corners are not equal." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: A display of the construction can help us follow the…
designs.meaning: "A display of the construction can help us follow the argument; a collection of successful measurements cannot replace it." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The visible line ends. / The statement about its extension…
designs.meaning: "The visible line ends. The statement about its extension does not." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The threshold belongs to the instrument; it is not the boundary of geometry itself." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

layers.text: FOR SO LONG THAT IT BECOMES

designs.meaning: "An assumption can be useful for so long that it becomes difficult to notice." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: It reads like a result. / It is asked for like a favour.
designs.meaning: "It reads like a result. It is asked for like a favour." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "Mostly it is in force BECAUSE it is not marked." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "That is a claim about everywhere along them. It is checked nowhere." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: I always believe the label first.
designs.meaning: "I always believe the label first." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Every time is not always. / A thousand triangles agree…
designs.meaning: "Every time is not always. A thousand triangles agree about a thousand triangles." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: there is nothing to walk to. / Not far: nothing.
designs.meaning: "On the gold line itself there is nothing to walk to. Not far: nothing." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Feeling like a consequence is not being one.
designs.meaning: "Feeling like a consequence is not being one." (Euclid_Parallel, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The eye is already around the next corner. The body would have to account for every step." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: These are movements around a model; / your feet remain on…
designs.meaning: "These are movements around a model; your feet remain on the museum floor." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: The descent was there to be found.
designs.meaning: "The descent was there to be found." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "We cannot end higher while also ending at the very same position, measured against the same up." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "the model can relocate that return, but cannot remove it." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "More construction has not yet supplied the missing connection." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "A gap becomes visible. Nothing in the beams has moved." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "Their images coincide. Their positions do not." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The mark offers a place from which to believe the image. You are allowed to leave it." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.title: Recognition is generous.
designs.meaning: "Recognition is generous." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "My eye checks pieces and reports the whole. Nobody checked the whole." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The return is still owed." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The return was not removed there either. It was paid outside the measurement" (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The picture was true of that one place and false of every other." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "That is the whole impossibility: not the counts, the following." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "It exists as a procedure (if you accept being moved)." (Escher_Impossible, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "There is no next value concealed behind it, waiting for the animation to reveal it. The program has not stored one." (Brouwer_Intuitionism, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "A single chosen 1 would answer yes. However long a run of zeros you have made, that run alone does not show that no later choice will be 1." (Brouwer_Intuitionism, foundationscrisis)

designs.meaning: "The freedom has a shape before your hand arrives." (Brouwer_Intuitionism, foundationscrisis)
